item.title: Self-Hosted Network Discovery Agents: lldpd vs SNMP Discovery vs arp-scan
item.description: Network discovery agents automatically detect and map devices on your network, providing visibility into connected hosts, switches, and infrastructure. Whether you need to audit your network inventory, detect unauthorized devices, or build a network topology map, the right discovery agent is essential for self-hosted infrastructure management. This guide compares lldpd, SNMP-based discovery tools, and arp-scan for network discovery use cases.
